description: Accept the Dataset License Agreement for a quoted order on the buyer's behalf. Call ONLY after the buyer has seen the tier, clip count, price, payment method, the agreement key terms, and the full agreement text, and has explicitly agreed. The buyer receives the accepted text by email. Free evaluation orders go straight to manual review; paid orders move on to checkout.

agreement_sha256.description: The sha256 from get_dataset_agreement or the quote.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the buyer explicitly approves the order and the agreement.

order_token.description: Private order_token returned by quote_training_dataset. Keep it out of public links and logs.

signer_name.description: Full name of the person authorizing the agreement.

name: accept_dataset_agreement
title: Accept the Dataset Agreement
